name: Wanted: "Hogger"
summary: Wanted: "Hogger" is an Alliance bounty posted outside Goldshire for the head of a massive, savage gnoll chieftain. Hogger prowls the southwestern woods of Elwynn Forest and has violently thwarted every attempt by the local authorities to bring him down.

sections.title: A Menace in the Woods
sections.body: While Elwynn Forest struggles with banditry and kobold infestations, the gnoll tribes in the south have grown bolder and more organized under the brute leadership of Hogger. Towering over typical Riverpaw gnolls, Hogger has established camp near the Forest's Edge, ambushing travelers and overpowering the local militia patrols sent to subdue him.

sections.title: Goldshire's Desperation
sections.body: With the Stormwind Army stretched thin and unable to spare regular forces to police the outskirts of the capital, Marshal Dughan took the unusual step of posting an open bounty on the beast. Taking down Hogger requires venture into deeply hostile gnoll territory, and his ferocity has earned him a reputation as the deadliest threat facing novice adventurers in Elwynn.

faq.answer: Hogger is an unusually large and savage gnoll leader terrorizing southwestern Elwynn Forest. He commands local packs around the Forest's Edge and has violently defeated all previous attempts by Stormwind guards to capture or kill him.
Hogger wanders among the gnoll encampments in southwestern Elwynn Forest, near the southern borders known as Forest's Edge, just north of the river boundary with Westfall and Duskwood.

faq.q: Why is there a bounty on Hogger?
faq.answer: The Stormwind Army placed a bounty on Hogger because he has overpowered local patrols and poses a lethal danger to travelers. With official troops stretched thin across the kingdom, Marshal Dughan turned to independent adventurers and bounty hunters to eliminate the threat.

faq.q: Who collects the proof of Hogger's death?
faq.answer: Proof of the beast's demise—his Huge Gnoll Claw—must be brought directly to Marshal Dughan, who commands the local garrison stationed in Goldshire.

faq.q: Why is Hogger so dangerous compared to other gnolls?
faq.answer: Unlike the common gnolls prowling Elwynn, Hogger possesses immense physical stature and brutality. He hits significantly harder and can withstand far more punishment, often overwhelming single combatants who underestimate him.

faq.q: Why can't the Stormwind guards handle Hogger themselves?
faq.answer: The kingdom's military resources are severely depleted and tied down defending major borders or dealing with the missing King Varian Wrynn. Marshal Dughan's small detachment in Goldshire lacks the manpower to safely hunt down such a resilient monster.

angles.text: Taking down Hogger is considered a rite of passage for young Alliance heroes testing their mettle in the defense of Stormwind's heartland.
For humans of Elwynn, slaying Hogger secures homesteads and road trade that have been terrorized by gnoll ambushes for months.
